subject: Erika Reinfeld School Committee Candidate Profile
overview: Incumbent School Committee member Erika Reinfeld presents her qualifications and priorities for re-election, emphasizing community engagement and the Medford High School building project.

items.title: Candidate Statement: Erika Reinfeld
items.summary: Incumbent Erika Reinfeld presents her platform for re-election, highlighting her professional background in STEM education and her commitment to the Medford High School project and educational equity.
